$comment: Q255: what an AI agent may start over MCP while the user is not looking. tools: MCP tools that run Gradle, the game or other heavy processes; they only run while the MCEdge app has the project open and, unless the user chose Allow without asking (Preferences > AI agents), after the user confirmed in the app. Without the app they are refused unless the MCP server was started with the flag or the environment variable below (unattended runs). approvalTimeoutSeconds: how long a call waits for the user's answer (silence refuses). presenceFreshSeconds: the app counts as open this long after its last heartbeat.
